title: Commit-gate timing pair (F153-FR-036; CQ-153-09 answered A on 2026-11-13)
description: The data of the timed pair of the commit gate: `commit_gate.started` opens the scan of one candidate, `commit_gate.ended` closes it. The pair is ADDITIVE catalogue rows — no new end cause is named (CQ-153-09 A) — and under the profile `parity` the switch `events.commitGateTiming` is off (row 144 of annex X §X.7), so the compatibility projection drops both types. The opener carries what is known before the scan runs (`durationMs` 0, `outcome` `clear`, `hits` 0); the closer carries the measured duration, the outcome and the hit count. No free text: a hit names a rule id, never the matched text, and `hits` is a count (F111-FR-031, F152-FR-010). PROPOSAL of spec 153 — not normative until its tasks land.

phase.$comment: the phase whose candidate the commit gate scanned

attempt.$comment: the attempt ordinal of the candidate within the phase

step.$comment: which commit-gate step is timed: the scan before the critic (F153-FR-024) or the gate before the approval commit (F152)

durationMs.$comment: the wall time of the scan in milliseconds; 0 on the opener

outcome.$comment: whether the scan blocked the candidate; `clear` on the opener

hits.$comment: the number of hits the scan answered; 0 on the opener

synthesized.$comment: true where the closer was written for an opener left open by a run that died mid-scan; the engine writes no synthesized member of this pair today, and the opener carries none
